description: Checks jobs, queues, budgets and the database, and records issues.

description: Records database size and connections every hour.

description: Hourly (identity.check_on): tests every active provider from stored data only for a malformed website, a website that does not match its registered identity, a domain shared with an unrelated provider, a redirect or parked domain, and a register change (pipeline.provider_identity_findings); raises one integration issue per kind; opens identity inve

description: Removes logs and copies older than their retention period, a small batch at a time.

description: Courses with no code printed by the university or regulator get a short StudySearch code (university, level, number). A code never changes.

description: Daily at 6:55 am Melbourne (daylight time): records each provider's courses, the courses holding each field and the provider fields held, for the daily per-provider coverage report. Keeps Settings › Pipeline settings › Storage & retention days.

label: Daily backup of publishing and settings
description: Daily at 6:50 am Melbourne (daylight time): keeps a copy of every provider's Published switch and every setting value, so a mistake can be put back (Settings › Backup & restore, Platform Admin). Keeps Settings › Pipeline settings › Storage & retention days.

description: Daily at 6:58 am Melbourne (daylight time): records the day before's use of each tool per provider (course search, page reads, AI page match, AI field reader, fee reader, scholarship AI, other credits, flags raised): used, worked, did not work, credits and US$. Keeps Settings › Pipeline settings › Storage & retention days.

description: Works out how complete each course and provider is.

description: Works out coverage state per course attribute.

description: Rebuilds the record of which source supplied each course value, for the Attributes panel.

label: Enrichment coverage snapshot
description: Hourly snapshot of enrichment coverage.

label: Admin figures cache
description: Refreshes figures shown on admin screens.

label: Data quality overview
description: Daily data quality figures.

label: Field coverage snapshot
description: Every hour: per country and field, how many active courses have the field. Shown on Layer 2 › Enrich fields.

label: Evidence filter options
description: Refreshes the filters on the Evidence screen.

label: Index evidence links
description: Links saved evidence to the records it supports.

label: Firecrawl panel figures
description: Refreshes the credit and result figures shown on the Firecrawl panel.

label: Lane funnels: count the stages of every lane
description: Each minute: counts the stages of each autonomous lane (intakes, fees, English, descriptions, entry requirements, scholarships, discovery, integrity) whose last count is older than Pipeline settings > Lane funnels > count each stage again after, one stage at a time within a time limit, and keeps the figures for Layer 2/3 > Operations. label: Weekly operational scorecard
description: Every morning (Melbourne): records the week so far against targets T1 to T8 (Pipeline settings › Operating targets) from existing measurements, keeping each day of job runs before the scheduler forgets it (about three days), and finalises the last week once after it ends. label: Snapshot progress (hourly)
description: Hourly at :09: refreshes each onboarding university's courses, fields and scholarships, and records the Progress overview for all universities, the pilot and the top 50; kept 90 days. Coverage & completeness › Progress.

label: University fee ranges
description: Works out each university's lowest and highest whole-course fee.

label: Rank providers by size
description: Ranks providers by number of active courses so the largest (top universities) are worked first.

label: 15-minute stats
description: Every 15 minutes: active courses and fields held for New Zealand and Canada with the change in 15 minutes and 24 hours, Firecrawl and AI use against their shares and guards, worker calls with failures and time, watchdog states, tasks waiting, and the gaps found (pipeline.stats_15m). Settings stats.*.

label: AI re-check of refused pages (nightly)
description: While AI admission is on, queues the next universities whose refused pages have not been read with the active model and instructions.

label: Read scholarship pages with AI
description: Sends queued scholarship pages to the active AI model (and the qualification sample to the model being qualified); each answer is checked against the page.

label: Scholarship audience from wording
description: Hourly: reads who each active scholarship is for from its own name, description and criteria (international, domestic, both, or not stated) and keeps the matched phrases as the basis. A value set by hand is never changed. A scholarship whose page states nothing is held from publishing until a person decides (Decision 244).

label: Publish scholarships automatically
description: Publishes scholarships that pass every check, as one batch named auto-publish.

label: Course scholarship attribute
description: Every 15 minutes: refreshes the scholarships shown on each course (search, website, Zoho) for courses linked to a scholarship that was changed, published, withdrawn or re-costed since the last run (Decision 247).

label: Course scholarship attribute (nightly sweep)
description: Nightly at 06:51 AEST, after the publication review and the savings run: refreshes the scholarships shown on every course that has a scholarship link or shows one (Decision 247).

label: Scholarship coverage: classify every case
description: Every hour at :29 (after coverage-reconcile): classifies each provider's scholarship cases in 13 states, verifies recoveries, and records unresolved cases with an owner, evidence, a next recovery time and an escalation in the work-continuity record (lane sch_coverage). Switch sch_cov.classify_on; size batch.sch_coverage_classify. Reads and records

description: Every hour at :31: at most batch.sch_coverage_recover once-per-case recovery actions (read a never-read register page, read a refused page again from its stored copy, traverse a listing). Each family has its own switch (sch_cov.recover_*), all off until the Platform Admin switches them on. Admits, decides and publishes nothing.

label: Discover scholarships
description: Finds scholarship pages on provider websites.

label: Line up providers for discovery
description: Keeps 30 providers waiting for scholarship discovery, adding the largest not yet searched.

label: Scholarship discovery: outcome for refused providers
description: Every hour at :16 (before the refill at :23): a discovery row the picker can never take (provider unpublished, search off, directory site, or not eligible under the Firecrawl scholarship rules) gets the status not_eligible with its reason instead of waiting for ever; it returns, due, when the reason clears. label: Scholarship fee alignment
description: Recalculates savings for courses whose fee changed.

description: Reads each provider's scholarship listing page through the scraper for the coverage check. Calls the worker only when security.worker_lane_call_v1 allows it: never while the lane is switched off or the job is on jobs.held_off, and, with lanes.skip_held_paid_calls on, not while its Firecrawl budget is held (the hold is recorded instead).

label: Scholarship listings: accept suggested catalogue pages
description: Every hour at :33: a suggested scholarship catalogue page of an admission-eligible provider, on its own site, becomes a listing source (read once by the normal listing reader, then on its cadence); at most batch.sch_coverage_recover a run, each once. Nothing happens while sch_cov.recover_listings_on is 0 or the scholarship Firecrawl share is held.

label: Scholarship nationality from wording
description: Hourly: reads which nationalities each active scholarship names in its own wording (country names, demonyms and regions) and keeps the matched phrase as the basis. An empty list means the page names none. A value set by hand is never changed (Decision 246).

label: Nightly publication review
description: Withdraws published scholarships that no longer qualify.

label: Read scholarship pages
description: Reads each scholarship's own page and records value, levels, field and closing date. Calls the worker only when security.worker_lane_call_v1 allows it: never while the lane is switched off or the job is on jobs.held_off, and, with lanes.skip_held_paid_calls on, not while its Firecrawl budget is held (the hold is recorded instead).

label: Re-check held scholarship pages
description: Every 2 minutes while held pages are queued: the first model of the scholarship chain answers who may apply and the value, each with its sentence; the result is a recommendation on the held item. Nothing is published or rejected.

label: Re-read published scholarships monthly
description: Daily at 05:37 AEST: a published or ready-to-publish scholarship's page is re-read at least every 30 days, so a changed value, percentage or closing date reaches courses and Zoho (Decision 247).

label: Work out scholarship savings
description: Works out the saving a year for percentage-off-tuition scholarships from each course's annual international fee.

label: Scholarship pages: retry transient read failures
description: Every hour at :37: a candidate scholarship page that stopped at the attempt cap on a time-out, a server error or a credit refusal is parked, then given one more set of reads (at most retry.scholarship_transient_cycles_max, batch.scholarship_transient_recover a run), only while the scholarship Firecrawl share is not held. Switch retry.scholarship_tr

label: API usage: daily statistics
description: Daily (about 00:20 Melbourne) and on demand from Operations > API usage: sums the API v2 request log into calls per day, key and action, rebuilds the statistics per key (24 hours, 7 days, 30 days) and removes log rows older than the setting.

label: Campus regional category
description: Updates each campus's metro or regional category.

label: Consumer API guard
description: Daily: compares what the website and Zoho read (API functions, the tables and columns behind them) with the frozen baseline; any change raises a hard flag (Decision 266).

label: Rebuild API reference data
description: Rebuilds the reference data the website API serves (providers, groups, fields).

label: Refresh search for changed courses
description: Updates search and the API for courses whose facts changed.

label: Website reference: build the copy
description: Every 15 minutes: builds the website API reference (vocabularies with counts) so the reference action answers at once.

label: Website sync: change check
description: Every minute: builds website API items in a rolling pass and numbers each new, changed or removed item (and each logo whose link is near its end) for the sync action.

label: Zoho sync: change check
description: Every minute: builds Zoho API v2 items (providers, campuses, contacts, courses of the countries in Zoho API settings) in a rolling pass and numbers each new, changed or removed item for the sync action and the CSV export.

label: Prepare removal of replaced snapshots
description: Every 5 minutes until done: checks replaced course-page snapshots against every column that refers to evidence; nothing is removed by the job.
